reason: B better targets the genuinely dynamic regime and proposes a testable transition to phonon-drag-controlled flow at ~10^3 s^-1, supported by a controlled strain-rate comparison and Co-containing baseline. Its low-rate dynamic-strain-aging/serration claim is weak and partly contradicted by E3, but A relies on unsupported assertions that Co removal increases lattice distortion and lowers stacking-fault energy, while its maximum rate of 0.1 s^-1 does not adequately probe dynamic behavior.
